body:
Looks very promising! I played around with it and have some feedback:
- Sometimes, the editor panel for the viewer disappears after a Lightmap node has been deselected. It doesn't reappear again until the editor has been restarted,
- The viewer doesn't account for directional lightmaps (which have 3 additional direction layers per a single lightmap layer). Using the shadowmask viewer on a directional lightmap and going beyond the shadowmask layer limit crashes the editor,
- Selecting an island zooms out to the entire lightmap, which can be disorienting

> Sometimes, the editor panel for the viewer disappears after a Lightmap node has been deselected. It doesn't reappear again until the editor has been restarted,

Yeah, it's a bit finicky. The dock should be visible when selecting a `LightmapGI` node or a node that's part of the baked lightmap data. I may have broken it at some point :sweat_smile: My first idea was to show it only when it's relevant but, while testing it during development, now I'm thinking that it should be always visible whenever a `LightmapGI` node is present in the scene.

> The viewer doesn't account for directional lightmaps (which have 3 additional direction layers per a single lightmap layer). Using the shadowmask viewer on a directional lightmap and going beyond the shadowmask layer limit crashes the editor,

Yup, I forgot about directional lightmaps :sweat_smile: I think I'll rework it to show all the relevant layers at the same time and have toggles to show/hide them like what I'm doing with the shadowmask texture.

> Selecting an island zooms out to the entire lightmap, which can be disorienting

Yes, this is true. I'll rework it to keep the zoom level and center the selected island in the panel if needed.

Thanks for testing it!
